content.text:
**xAI Grok CLI** (officially known as **Grok Build**) is a powerful terminal-based AI coding agent from xAI (sometimes referred to as SpaceXAI in documentation). It runs as a full-screen, flicker-free TUI (Terminal User Interface) that understands your codebase, proposes plans, edits files with clean diffs, runs shell commands, performs web searches, uses subagents in parallel, integrates with Git, and supports complex engineering workflows.[[1]](https://x.ai/news/grok-build-cli)

It is powered by models like Grok 4.5 and is designed for professional software engineering. Key capabilities include:
- **Plan mode**: Generates a structured plan you can review, comment on, or rewrite before execution.
- **Subagents**: Spawns parallel specialized agents (with optional separate worktrees).
- **Skills, plugins, hooks, MCP servers**: Works out-of-the-box with AGENTS.md for project conventions; supports reusable skills (/skillify), hooks on file edits/tool calls, and integrations (e.g., Linear, Sentry).
- **Headless mode** (`grok -p "task"`): Ideal for scripts, CI/CD, and automation; supports JSON output and structured schemas.
- **Other features**: Memory across sessions, code search, multi-file edits, deep reasoning, terminal execution with live streaming, sandboxing, theming, custom models, and Agent Client Protocol (ACP) for editor/IDE integration.[[2]](https://x.ai/cli)

It is available to **SuperGrok and X Premium Plus subscribers** (with some free access tiers mentioned in later updates) and runs on macOS (Apple Silicon), Linux (x86_64/arm64), and Windows (x86_64).[[3]](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@xai-official/grok)

### Installation
The recommended way is the official one-liner:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://x.ai/cli/install.sh | bash
```

- On **Windows (PowerShell)**: `irm https://x.ai/cli/install.ps1 | iex`
- Via npm (unofficial wrapper/distribution): `npm i -g @xai-official/grok`
- After install, run `grok` for the interactive TUI or `grok -p "your task"` for headless use.
- First launch opens a browser for authentication with your xAI/SuperGrok account. For headless/CI: `export XAI_API_KEY="xai-..."` (get keys from console.x.ai).
- Update with `grok update` (or `npm i -g @xai-official/grok@latest` if installed via npm).[[4]](https://grok.com/share/c2hhcmQtNA_58def094-cee5-4035-bc11-5f812e8bd7f4)

Verify with `grok --version`.

### Documentation and Source
- Official page: [https://x.ai/cli](https://x.ai/cli) (or https://x.ai/news/grok-build-cli for the announcement).[[1]](https://x.ai/news/grok-build-cli)
- Full docs: [https://docs.x.ai/build/overview](https://docs.x.ai/build/overview) — covers config (`~/.grok/config.toml`), keyboard shortcuts, slash commands, MCP servers, custom models, headless usage, etc.[[5]](https://r.jina.ai/https:/docs.x.ai/build/overview)
- GitHub (Rust source, periodically synced): [https://github.com/xai-org/grok-build](https://github.com/xai-org/grok-build) — includes user guide with details on skills, plugins, hooks, sandboxing, and more.[[6]](https://github.com/xai-org/grok-build/blob/main/README.md)

**Note**: There are third-party tools with similar names (e.g., an open-source `@stevederico/grok-cli` that supports multiple providers including Grok via API key). The official xAI product is Grok Build / the `grok` binary from x.ai/cli.[[7]](https://github.com/stevederico/grok-cli)

For the latest details, visit the official links above, as features continue to evolve (launched in early beta around May 2026 and expanded later).
